units.source_text: “仔细一看，它确实是女性化呀。”

en.t: When you look closely, it really is feminine.

units.source_text: 真一说，“不论是垂下的细枝，还是花儿，

en.t: Shin'ichi said, “Whether it is the slender drooping branches or the flowers,

units.source_text: 都使人感到十分温柔和丰盈……”

en.t: they all give a feeling of great gentleness and fullness...”
